verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Codegen's docs site serves a working llms.txt at https://docs.codegen.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) listing structured doc links, directly enabling an agent to be pointed at agent-oriented docs; this is corroborated by extensive first-party documentation of agent-friendly interfaces (SDK, CLI, API). Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of agents actually consuming the llms.txt in practice.
